integrity: All assertions are proven by an explicit product identity, rational upper bounds, and a finite exact prime enumeration below \(384\). The attached independent direct computation through \(400000\) is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns \(n>1\) with \(\omega(n)\le6\), not more than six distinct prime factors; prior literature includes isolated six-prime examples and a separate seven-prime family. Potential unindexed elementary proofs remain a novelty risk.
title: Complete six-prime-support classification of the Dedekind–totient inequality
